admission.justification: Root selection, bounded response and disclosed omissions/capture address different ways the same mechanical comparison could appear complete or side-effect-free when it is not. JM868W adds capture disclosure to the overlap with PPGGTW; X23FME supplies scope admission. Their actual scopes remain unchanged; one member does not establish all three parts.

guarantee: For the declared converted knowledge_diff requests, root admission and an absent-selector refusal prevent a falsely empty comparison. The response stays within the shared knowledge-read threshold and states omitted files and patch cuts; within the recorded capture obligation's scope, loose-object capture is disclosed. This is a mechanical file comparison, not a semantic verdict or canonical-dataset comparison.
title: Explicit scope and limits of mechanical knowledge diff
